title: view_skew_check prints 'no generated view was touched' on a commit that contains one: the message names the general category while the check covers 1 of 269, so a known gap is reported at the gate as an empty category
body:
# 0075: `view_skew_check` prints "no generated view was touched" on a commit that contains one

## Tags

gates, runner, parity-tools, scope-honesty, false-assurance, measured

## Summary

**The commit gate printed `skew: no generated view was touched by this change -- nothing to check.` on a commit whose diff contained a generated view.** Driven at `0f442175` (vc, 2026-08-24 20:05Z), which committed `intent/st/ST0056/acceptance.md` -- a file whose own first paragraph reads **THIS FILE IS A GENERATED VIEW, AND A ROW AUTHORED HERE IS DISCARDED BY THE NEXT SYNC** -- and drew exactly that line.

**The instrument is not wrong about what it measured. It is wrong about what it NAMES.** `view_skew_check.sh` covers the parity APPARATUS views. The commit touched a THREAD view. The message says *generated view*, which covers both.

## Measured

| fact | value | control |
| ---- | ----- | ------- |
| banner, `bin/.devbin/cmd/precommit:75` | `skew: committed generated views still match their canon` | plural, general, no qualifier |
| runtime line, `view_skew_check.sh:223` | `skew: no generated view was touched by this change -- nothing to check.` | printed at `0f442175` |
| generated view in that commit | `intent/st/ST0056/acceptance.md` | self-declares GENERATED VIEW in its header |
| `thread_view_skew` mentions in the runner | **0** | `view_skew_check` mentions: **4** |
| roster, read from source `precommit:103-118` | 13 guards; `view_skew_check.sh` present | `thread_view_skew_check.sh` absent |

## This is NOT 0059, and it is NOT the wiring gap

**0059 is the never-ran class** -- an instrument with no execution site, where a check that never ran is indistinguishable from one that ran green. It is CLOSED. This instrument has an execution site, runs, and returns 0.

**The wiring gap is known, owned and already quantified by dc**, in `thread_view_skew_check.sh`'s own header: *"the gate's skew coverage is 1 of 269 and the missing 268 are the thread covers, the acceptance contracts and the work package covers -- the files a hand edit silently loses at the next sync."* **That figure is not this issue's finding and this issue does not restate it as new.**

**WHAT IS NEW IS THAT THE MESSAGE CONVERTS A KNOWN GAP INTO AN ACTIVE FALSE ASSURANCE, AT THE ONE MOMENT AN OPERATOR IS LOOKING FOR REASSURANCE.** A reader who knows coverage is 1 of 269 still reads *no generated view was touched -- nothing to check* on a commit that touched one, and **the sentence tells them the CATEGORY WAS EMPTY rather than that it was UNCHECKED. Those are different claims and only one of them is true.** A silent gap gets found; a gap that files a clean report on its own behalf does not.

## The runner already states the rule this line breaks

`bin/.devbin/cmd/precommit:25-31`, in a comment:

> COVERAGE IS REPORTED AS MEASURED, NEVER AS DESIGNED. Measured 2026-08-15: view_skew covers ONE of thirty apparatus views (`dispatch-table.md` is the only one re-derivable from committed state) [...] Do not write those numbers into this file as constants -- **the guards print what they actually checked**

The comment is right and the guard does not obey it. **A rule stated in a comment beside the code that breaks it is the easiest kind of drift to walk past, because the file reads as though the question had already been considered.**

## Class -- the third instance, in the third tool

Same family as **0069** (dc's framing: *the confirmation line carries ONE HARDCODED NOUN regardless of what the operation actually touched*) and **0074** (*"no staged elixir files" when it means "no coverage for the files you staged"*). **Three instances now, three different tools, one shape: a TRUE statement about the instrument's own narrow scope, printed in the vocabulary of the general category.** Worth reading together rather than fixing three times; the recurrence is the finding.

## Fix

Name the scope in the message: *apparatus view*, not *generated view*, in both the banner and the runtime line. Where the commit DOES touch a thread view, say so and say it was **not checked** -- never report the category empty. One line in each of two files, no logic change.

**DO NOT close this by wiring `thread_view_skew_check.sh`.** That is a separate, larger, already-owned change, and doing it here would close this issue by making its sentence ACCIDENTALLY TRUE rather than HONEST -- leaving the same defect in place for whatever the gate does not cover next.

## Owner

Routed to **dc**: `bin/.devbin/` and `intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/` are theirs. Filed by vc, 2026-08-24 20:05Z.
